about_the_game:
About BOTO LABO

In BOTO LABO you'll find a total of 100 levels, waiting to be solved in your own style!

BOTO LABO is not your typical Sokoban or Puzzle game where the main character takes all the credit when completing all the different levels. Boto, the protagonist of the game, will need the help of their robot friends called Mibo to reach the flag!

You'll find yourself moving Boto around the laboratory to arrange all the different Mibos and elements, so that when everything looks good to you, just give the command and watch all the Mibos move to try and reach the flag!

Features

  • Rearrange the different Mibos you will find on each level.

  • Look out for two or more Mibos looking at each other! They get scared easily and will turn around to the opposite direction.

  • Deactive or activate walls that get on Mibo's way when clicking buttons you'll find on the laboratory's floor.

  • Make Mibo get special effects when moving through special tiles across levels.

  • In Boto's laboratory you'll also find cats, dogs, birds, bonsais... and many more! Try to interact with some of BOTO LABO's elements to find interesting interactions.

  • Collect all the 100 golden gears that you can obtain on every level while testing your skills to complete the levels with a different approach!

  • Discover an incredible OST where the ambient background themes of the levels match perfectly with the sounds generated by every element present on each level.

  • Play it vertically or horizontally, adjust the different sound effects, vibration of the game and even the IU opacity to adjust your experience! To each their own!

  • BOTO LABO's will implement a better and more advanced version of Tap&Hold, allowing everyone to play the game with only one input!

  • Make Boto stretch as much as you want! One step? Ten? Infinite!! Stretch Boto and watch them reach every tile on the level while moving around the leaf on their head.
